content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 because required prior authorization was missing, and Silverbridge does not offer retroactive authorization or peer-to-peer review. Resubmission or records alone would not cure the authorization denial, while a formal appeal is still available and is the only payer-directed action with any success among similar claims. The payer path is therefore not exhausted, so patient billing or write-off is premature.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
